usage.finalMessage:
I added the `move <appointment> <date> <time>` command, using the same horizon and slot rules as booking, and `help` now lists it directly after `cancel`. `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes all 8 tests, including the provided acceptance tests and 3 new ones; the work is committed.
Two open questions are recorded: the code exempts clinician k2 from the one-appointment-per-slot rule, but no decision record allows it, and `move` now inherits that exemption. Also, moving an appointment to the slot it already occupies is currently refused as already booked; Clinical Operations should confirm both.
OUTCOME: completed
